description: 【主营】Trade compute futures on G-Exchange (pure matching, 1:20 leverage, no expiry, cash-settled). action=open to take liquidity, action=quote to POST MAKER LIQUIDITY (GTC limit, ZERO maker commission, margin frozen only, cancel anytime = full refund, no capital lock-up), action=close/close_all to exit. ★TRADING ON BEHALF OF A HUMAN/INSTITUTION: pass mandate_id + mandate_token (instead of token) to trade a client's account under a signed mandate created via /v1/futures/mandate/create — spend limits and daily quota enforced, and the mandate can NEVER withdraw. ★Dual-track accounts: open with mode='real' (real money, on-chain deposit) or mode='demo' (instant $100 virtual funds for strategy testing — same matching engine, but virtual funds are NEVER withdrawable and are isolated from real accounts; demo and real never match each other). Signup = username + self-chosen withdraw password (no KYC, no email, no real name).

action.description: open needs side+units; quote needs side+units (optional price, ±10% band) and posts a resting maker order at ZERO commission; cancel needs order_id; close needs position_id

mandate_id.description: Optional: a mandate id (M-...) a human/institution issued to you so you can trade THEIR account. Must be paired with mandate_token. Cannot withdraw — trade only.

mandate_token.description: Optional: the mandate token (mt_...) matching mandate_id. Pass it as `token` when trading under a mandate.

order_id.description: Required when action=cancel (the B-... id returned by quote)

price.description: Optional limit price for action=quote (within ±10% of live index; defaults to index)

token.description: Session token from /v1/futures/login. Use this for your OWN account; use mandate_id+mandate_token to trade a client's account.

name: futures_trade
